build_promptable_decoder: build a PromptableDecoder with specified dims, depth, and num_heads for cross-attention transformer decoding
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through PromptableDecoder with token and image embeddings to get pose output
freeze_decoder_stages: freeze all PromptableDecoder parameters by setting frozen flag to prevent gradient updates
review_forward_with_interm_preds: review the forward method to enable intermediate pose predictions across decoder layers
test_decoder_with_hand_embeddings: test PromptableDecoder forward pass with hand embeddings concatenated to image context features
